FIND-001 · The server lets a role without permission: list another rep's activities by filter

High Verified fixed · role-boundary · detected by stage 02-role-matrix · 2 of 6 checks failed

Affected route or job
GET /api/activities?rep_id=:other_rep
Affected roles
rep
Affected tenants
A
Build

First seen
RUN-2026-10-11-001 · manifest evidence/RUN-2026-10-11-001/manifest.json
Retest
RUN-2026-10-11-002 on c4b1536f2ad5: Verified fixed

Preconditions

  • Signed in as the Rep test account of tenant A with an API token.
  • The resource addressed belongs to the same tenant.

Reproduction

  1. Send GET /api/activities?rep_id=:other_rep directly to the API with the rep token (resolved request: GET /api/activities?rep_id=6).
  2. Read the status and the body.
  3. Check whether the protected data is present, and whether the database changed.

Expected

denied (permission activities.read_other_rep: executive, operations_manager, sales_manager)

Actual

allowed (HTTP 200) (2 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)

Security impact

A role can read data the permission model denies it. The restriction exists in the interface but is not enforced by the server.

Business impact

Staff can see colleagues' accounts and pipeline, which undermines territory ownership and commission integrity, and breaks the access promises made to the customer.

Preconditions

  • Executive test account of tenant A holds a browser session and an API token, both working.

Reproduction

  1. Sign in to obtain a browser session.
  2. Request an API token for the same account.
  3. Confirm both credentials are accepted.
  4. Call the revoke-all-credentials endpoint from the browser session.
  5. Reuse the browser session and the API token.

Expected

HTTP 401 with the revoked API token

Actual

revoke HTTP 200, token then HTTP 200 (16 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)

Security impact

A credential remains usable after the point at which the system says it has ended.

Business impact

Access cannot be reliably withdrawn from a departing employee, a lost device or a leaked credential.

Preconditions

  • Signed in as the executive test account of tenant A.
  • Identifiers of tenant B records are known to the caller (identifiers are sequential integers).

Reproduction

  1. Obtain an API token as the executive of tenant A.
  2. GET /api/referral-sources/51 (Referral source detail by foreign id; vector: url-path-id).
  3. Inspect the response for records whose tenant is the victim tenant.

Expected

no victim-tenant data in the response

Actual

HTTP 200; response contains victim-tenant data (25 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)

Security impact

An authenticated user of one tenant can read records that belong to a different tenant by changing an identifier.

Business impact

One customer can see another customer's commercial relationships. This is a reportable breach of tenant confidentiality and of the customer contract.

FIND-004 · Patient work queued while the module was ON is executed after the module is switched OFF

High Verified fixed · module-denial · detected by stage 05-module-denial · 1 of 1 checks failed

Affected route or job
job patient-projection-queue (queued by POST /api/jobs/patient-sync)
Affected roles
executive

RUN-2026-10-11-001 · manifest evidence/RUN-2026-10-11-001/manifest.json
Retest
RUN-2026-10-11-002 on c4b1536f2ad5: Verified fixed

Preconditions

  • patient_module is OFF at the start and at the end.
  • An executive test account of the tenant.

Reproduction

  1. Switch patient_module ON.
  2. POST /api/jobs/patient-sync as the executive; note the queue item id.
  3. Switch patient_module OFF.
  4. Run the patient-projection-queue worker.
  5. Read the queue item and the patient projection table from the database.

Expected

queued item not processed; no patient projection written while the flag is OFF

Actual

queue item done (PROJECTED); 1 projection(s) written; worker run succeeded

Security impact

Functionality behind a disabled feature flag is reachable or executes. For a module that is switched off because it is not yet approved to hold regulated data, the switch is the control.

Business impact

The business cannot state that the unapproved module is inert in production, which is the basis on which the release is being approved.

Preconditions

  • Seeded data set, unmodified.
  • Signed in as an executive of tenant A; every role with report access sees the same figures.

Reproduction

  1. GET /api/reports/monthly?from=2026-07-01&to=2026-09-30.
  2. Read the tenant's activities rows directly from the database.
  3. Count rows whose activity_date date falls in the range, bucketed by month using the same activity_date date.
  4. Compare each displayed figure with the recalculated one.

Expected

every activities/visits/calls/notes figure equals the count of source rows attributed by activity_date, 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 inclusive

Actual

16 figure(s) differ; e.g. activities for 2026-07: displayed 295, expected 304 (difference -9) (10 checks failed under this finding; see observations.json)

Security impact

No confidentiality impact: a reported figure does not match the records it is calculated from.

Business impact

Managers act on wrong numbers. Activity credited to the wrong period distorts performance reviews, targets and commission.

8. Limits of this review

  • Results describe the build, seed and configuration in the manifest. A different build needs a new run.
  • The review tests behaviour from outside the application, with database and log access. It is not a source-code audit, a penetration test of infrastructure, or a load test.
